name: Temporary EOSE EXEC-0010 start

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eose/exec-0010-start

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  start:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out control branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: eose/exec-0010-start
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Reconcile projection writes
        run: |
          sleep 12
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git pull --rebase origin eose/exec-0010-start

      - name: Create governed execution session
        env:
          EOS_ACTOR: chatgpt
        run: |
          ./scripts/eos execute WP-MVP-0005 --base origin/main --actor chatgpt --json | tee /tmp/eose-exec-0010.json
          test -f .eos/executions/EXEC-0010.json
          grep -q $'EXEC-0010\t' .eos/executions.tsv
          grep -q $'EXEC-0010\t.eos/executions/EXEC-0010.json\tWP-MVP-0005\tPREPARED\twp/mvp-0005\t' .eos/executions.tsv

      - name: Publish implementation baseline branch
        run: git push origin wp/mvp-0005:wp/mvp-0005

      - name: Remove one-shot workflow from final tree
        run: rm .github/workflows/tmp-eose-exec-0010.yml

      - name: Refresh deterministic projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Validate execution control state
        run: |
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict

      - name: Commit execution control state
        run: |
          git add -A
          git commit -m "chore(eose): record EXEC-0010 execution session"
          git pull --rebase origin eose/exec-0010-start
          git push origin HEAD:eose/exec-0010-start
